s313-D56.quote: SWITCH, CHECKBOX, RADIO AND CHIP: FOUR PARTS, OR FOUR TREES IN ONE PART: FOUR PARTS. The page asked, verbatim: 'Four parts, or four trees in one part? Recommendation: four parts. s313-D60.quote: DOES THE BORDER FOLLOW THE INK IN DARK TOO: YES, THE INK IN DARK AS WELL. s313-D61.quote: DO THE SUCCESS MARKS FOLLOW THE INK TOO: THE BIG TICK FOLLOWS; THE SMALL SUCCESS MARK KEEPS ITS GREEN. s313-D68.quote: THE TOAST HAS NO ERROR KIND; ERRORS GO TO THE ALERT: RIGHT AS IT IS: ERRORS GO TO THE ALERT. The page asked, verbatim: 'Your toast answer said "at once only for errors". s313-D71.quote: THE FOCUS RING ONLY BY TABBING: THE COMPONENTS TOO, OR THE SHOWROOM'S BAR ONLY: THE COMPONENTS TOO. s313-D73.quote: THE SQUARE-CORNER TOKEN'S NAME: JOIN. The page asked, verbatim: 'What is the token called?'; its recommendation, verbatim: 'Recommended: join. It names the job, the corners where two controls meet, the way the other radius tokens name a role, and it stays true if a theme ever softens those corners.'; Dave, by click, verbatim: 'join' (the recommendation); comment: none.

s313-D74.quote: A PLAIN ZERO ON ONE CORNER BESIDE TOKEN CORNERS IS NOW REFUSED: STANDS. s314-D1.quote: THE EDGE IN LIGHT MODE STAYS AS RULED: INVISIBLE IN LIGHT, GREY IN DARK; AND, BY HIS COMMENT, THERE IS NEVER A FOCUS STATE UNLESS THE PERSON IS USING KEYBOARD CONTROLS (his comment is the word lane AM enacted under s313-D71). s314-D2.quote: THE ACCOUNT MENU KEEPS THE SAME EDGE AS EVERY OTHER FLOATING SURFACE; ITS OLD GREY LINE DOES NOT COME BACK (the tree already draws this, s313-D58 at 4d62f3c0; nothing to build). s314-D4.quote: SWITCH, CHECKBOX, RADIO AND CHIP ARE EACH OFFERED FOR THE INPUT ROLE, BESIDE SELECTION CONTROLS. s314-D7.quote: THE PAGE TEMPLATES ARE ONLY EXAMPLE OR INSPIRATION FOR DESIGNERS, PROPERLY BUILT, AND AUTOMATED BUILDS IGNORE THEM AND NEVER TRACE A PAGE, by his comment; NOT the page's recommendation (he chose none of the options).
